title: Effekten van de film 'Uitspraak over 14 dagen' 1978
authors: Hentenaar, F., Instituut voor psychologisch marktonderzoek, IPM * Schiedam (primary investigator)
contributors: Instituut voor psychologisch markt- en motieven onderzoek, IPM * Schiedam (data collector)
descriptions: Information on, attitude towards jurisdiction, course of trial, role of police, judge, witness, prosecutor, etc., seriousness of crimes / knowledge of juridical concepts / aims of jurisdiction / media exposure / opinion on film / experiences with judicature. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ occupation/employment/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
